patterns.what_worked: Keeping every new widget behind an explicit == true toggle kept the existing call-count assertions intact (no default-visible change, no extra reads in the all-off configurations). The D4 sampler living in the guide gather made the frozen time_to_die integration point testable end-to-end (the new W8 Bite check), and the mutation proof on the final tree caught both a constant break and the Era gate break. Re-checking the shared tree before the pips wiring let me confirm the installed ST:new_pips signature and prune the probe to the real colon path instead of guessing.
patterns.what_was_hard: Two real bugs found by the new checks: the first TTD sample never stored its baseline (throttle branch swallowed it), and the power-type read gate initially omitted the omen toggle so the glow could never see cat form. Also, adding HUD slots is a cross-lane artifact: hud_state pins the druid slot list exactly, so its 4 rows now fail until the reconcile pass (bars_state's DRUID count row likewise - both exact updates are in the bench report).
patterns.skill_gap: Offline harness cannot load the addon: every new visual (pips row, countdown text, badge, omen halo, GCD marker), the design reset anchor and the TF/Berserk off-GCD status stay UNCONFIRMED until an in-client check.
